结果 ♂: HR says they'll "take it seriously". Two weeks later, the investigation concludes the "communication style was inappropriate", and Daniel attends a training session. In the kitchen, people wonder whether you've had it in for Daniel all along. Mia doesn't get the permanent role.

规则书: Someone's come to you for help! Being a leader means listening to everyone. Just don't forget: team harmony comes first.
